These rules and standards shall apply to the development of economic and socialized housing projects in urban and rural areas as defined in Section 2 of BP Blg. 220. They shall apply to the development of either a house and lot or a house or lot only.
Development of economic and socialized housing projects shall be in accordance with the minimum design standards herein set forth.
Generally, housing projects should conform with the zoning ordinance of the city/municipality where they are located, thus, shall be in suitable sites for housing.

However, where there is no zoning ordinance or land use plan, the predominant land use principle and site suitability factors cited herein shall be used in determining suitability of a project to a site.

The minimum horizontal dimension of courts and yards shall not be less than 2.0 meters. All inner courts shall be connected to a street or yard, either by a passageway with a minimum width of 1.20 meters or by a door through a room or rooms.
The minimum floor area requirement for single-family dwelling shall be 22 square meters for economic housing and 18 square meters for socialized housing.
- a) Rooms for habitable use shall be provided with windows with a total free area of openings equal to at least 10% of the floor area of the room.
- b) Bathrooms shall be provided with window/s with an area not less than 1/20 of its floor area.
